stress_10000_worlds.purpose: outcome-stratified stress diagnostic, not representative or a tuning panel

seed_noise_floor.definition: larger absolute endpoint of the paired 95% independent-seed interval

protocol.shared_seeds: same starting seed, not proof random draws remain aligned across different mechanisms
protocol.cutoff_limitations: F1-F3 require dated assignment fits and rebuilt matchup features; first-retained-season fallback priors need correction before promotion

commands.control: .venv/bin/python -u scripts/backtest.py --config models/v1.2d.json --models folds/v1.2d_F4_all --fold F4 --games 200 --seed 20261119 --worlds 1000 --jobs 4 --rotation targets --pool 0 --name a1_s01_control
commands.independent_seed: .venv/bin/python -u scripts/backtest.py --config models/v1.2d.json --models folds/v1.2d_F4_all --fold F4 --games 200 --seed 20261119 --worlds 1000 --jobs 4 --rotation targets --pool 0 --simulation-stream 1 --name a1_s01_seed2
commands.confirmation: Run the manifest IDs with --game-ids, --seed-key a1-confirmation-<fold> and --simulation-stream 0; repeat with stream 1. Fit dated fold inputs first.
